post.description:
Force a replay: the orchestrator resets the edit to ``selecting``. Operator hosts
only: on the public host a replay would re-run the whole pipeline outside Simulate's
one-run-per-visitor gate and spend the shared daily cap.

get.description: Newest first; with ``since``, oldest first after that id (the polling fallback).

``id:``/``event:``/``data:`` frames; heartbeat comment every 15 s; resumes after
``Last-Event-ID`` (or ``since``), else streams only new events. At most
``ratchet_sse_max_per_client`` streams per client and ``ratchet_sse_max_streams`` in
total; over that, 429 ``rate_limited``.
Host configuration for the SPA. Issues the ``ratchet_session`` cookie on first call.
The anonymous demo funnel. Operator host only (403 ``not_public``).

post.description:
The replay becomes the golden; the old golden is archived (reason ``drift``). On the
public host this writes a session-scoped golden copy and never touches the library.

get.description: Recent runs, newest first; ``unblessed=1`` (default) leaves out the goldens.

post.description: Mark a live run golden (PII pass, Nano enrichment). Refused on the public host.

Apply the scenario's seeded edit in this session's copy of the skills repo. The
response carries the pre-allocated ``verdict_id`` so the client can open it at once.

when another action on this verdict is in progress).
